subject: Commons Contrib Sprint — maintainer credit pilot request
messages:
From: Ava Brooks <ava.brooks@commonscontrib.org>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request — maintainer credits for Commons Contrib Sprint

Hi Mina,

Hope you’re well — I’m reaching out from Commons Contrib where we run an annual three-day sprint connecting maintainers from 120 projects. Historically we give small compute/credits stipends to maintainers to offset time and infra costs.

This year we’re piloting a program to distribute platform credits (to be used for inference/testing) to 40 maintainers who’ll be doing live demos and mentoring sessions. We’d love Redwood Inference to sponsor the credit pool and provide trial extensions for a subset of heavier users.

High level ask: $6k equivalent in platform credits, 6-month trial extensions for up to 12 maintainers, and a short blurb in our sponsor page acknowledging Redwood. We’ve attached a short pilot proposal.

Timeline: sprint runs Nov 6–8; maintainers need account access and credits by Oct 20 to prepare.

Can you point me to the right person to approve and what info you’ll need?

Thanks,
Ava Brooks
Community Programs Manager
Commons Contrib

Attachment: credits_pilot_proposal.pdf (1 page)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Brooks <ava.brooks@commonscontrib.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request — maintainer credits for Commons Contrib Sprint

Thanks for the note, Ava — great to hear from you and congrats on scaling the event.

Quick answers: we can usually support community credit pilots like this. I’ll need to scope three things before I can confirm: 1) total credit amount split (hosted vs. dedicated allowances), 2) list of maintainer accounts (or an admin invite workflow), and 3) any special data residency/SLA requirements for demonstrations.

Looping in Marissa from partnerships and Karthik from community ops to coordinate approvals and accounting. Marissa — can you weigh in on sponsor recognition and any marketing commitments? Karthik — could you confirm the quickest path to issue trial extensions and whether we can do per-user capped credit grants?

If it helps, Ava, could you share a one-page list of the 40 maintainers and a short note on the heavier-use group (12 people)? We’ll try to turn around a decision within a week.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Partnerships Manager, Developer Relations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request — maintainer credits for Commons Contrib Sprint

+1 from Partnerships — I’m supportive. A few notes:

- Marketing: we can provide a sponsor blurb and a small co-branded banner if Commons Contrib accepts standard logos + a short quote (TBD).
- Budget: $6k in platform credits is within typical pilot ranges. Please confirm whether that’s in-hosted API credits (preferred) or a mix.
- Reporting: we’ll ask Commons Contrib for a short post-event usage report tied to the HubSpot reference so we can evaluate ROI.

Mina — if Ops can handle the provisioning and terms look standard, I’m happy to approve sponsor copy and the credits commitment.

Marissa
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request — maintainer credits for Commons Contrib Sprint

Internal ops note and draft terms attached.

Summary of constraints:
- We can allocate $6,000 in hosted API credit units split into 40 grants of $125 each, plus an additional pool of $2,000 earmarked for the 12 heavy users to receive an extra $166 each (total pilot ~$8,000).
- Trial extensions: 6-month extension is doable for accounts created via our admin provisioning flow; we’ll need a CSV of maintainer emails and consent to TOS updates.
- SLA/data residency: no special SLA changes required for demos; standard hosted tenancy is fine.

Next steps:
1) Ava to share maintainer list CSV and indicate which 12 need higher allotments.
2) Marissa to confirm sponsor messaging and sign-off on the $8k total pilot estimate.
3) Ops (Karthik) to provision accounts and load credits once we have the CSV and HubSpot ticket.

Attachments: terms_sla_draft.docx (2 pages)

Rishi
Senior Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ava Brooks <ava.brooks@commonscontrib.org>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request — maintainer credits for Commons Contrib Sprint

Thanks all — this looks great. I’ve attached the maintainer CSV to the HubSpot ticket (HS-23941) and flagged the 12 heavy users in the notes. Commons Contrib is happy with the sponsor blurb you proposed.

We accept the $8k pilot estimate. Please let me know if you need signed paperwork — I can route a quick sponsorship form. Otherwise we’d appreciate credits provisioned by Oct 20.

Best,
Ava
Community Programs Manager
Commons Contrib
